task.title: Align E2E RBAC issuer readiness verification with the canonical UI contract
task.objective: Replace the obsolete issuer-readiness text assertion in verify:e2e-rbac with a resilient observable derived from the production readiness rendering while preserving the complete role, route-guard and direct-IPC authorization coverage; prove the assertion fails when readiness rendering is broken; close and export the Bead; reconcile project state; commit coherently to main; push normally; and preserve all unrelated work.

security: Do not change issuer key resolution, key custody, signing, authorization or readiness behavior; this is a verifier-only correction.
Never expose key material or manufacture an issuer key.
compatibility: Retain every existing route-guard and direct-IPC RBAC assertion.
Do not replace the obsolete text with another single fragile display string.

awkit-vpje is closed and exported, project state and exact roadmap pins are reconciled, the implementation is committed to main and pushed normally, and preserved baseline work is not overwritten.
